zh.title: Simple Flying：達美航空逐步退役波音757
zh.summary: Simple Flying報導達美逐步退役757；替換機型非易事
body: 航空業媒體Simple Flying於2026年9月14日發表報導，標題為「The Real Reason Why Delta Air Lines Is Retiring Its Boeing 757s Gradually Instead Of All At Once」。報導指出達美航空正在逐步退役其波音757機隊，而非一次性全部退役，且摘要強調「Replacing its 757s is far easier said than done for Delta」，顯示機隊替換過程存在困難。
此為媒體分析報導，非達美航空官方正式公告。報導未在標題與摘要中揭示具體退役時間表、替換機型細節或官方說明。本站依公開可得的標題與摘要資訊呈現，後續發展仍待官方資訊確認。

en.title: Simple Flying Reports Delta Air Lines Retiring Boeing 757s Gradually
en.summary: Simple Flying reports Delta retiring 757s gradually; replacement remains challenging
body: Aviation publication Simple Flying reported on September 14, 2026, under the headline "The Real Reason Why Delta Air Lines Is Retiring Its Boeing 757s Gradually Instead Of All At Once." The article states Delta Air Lines is retiring its Boeing 757 fleet gradually rather than all at once, with the summary noting that replacing the 757s "is far easier said than done for Delta," indicating fleet replacement challenges.

This is a media analysis report, not an official Delta Air Lines announcement. The headline and summary do not disclose specific retirement timelines, replacement aircraft details, or official statements. SKYTICAL presents this based on publicly available headline and summary information; further developments await official confirmation.
